title: Vucko Scroll Animation
description: A tiny centered video preview grows from a 0.25 thumbnail to full scale as the intro section scrolls into view, driven by a GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub timeline (start top bottom, end top 10%) whose onUpdate interpolates translateY, scale, gap and a two-phase title font-size. A requestAnimationFrame loop applies the transforms and adds an eased mouse-follow horizontal parallax, all under Lenis smooth scroll.

images.desc: film crew on location mid-shoot, desaturated cinematic still used as the Slate studio reel poster
images.role: reel-preview poster that scales to full-bleed in the scroll intro

intent.useWhen: Cuando quieras revelar un video o showreel al hacer scroll: crece de miniatura a pantalla completa con parallax de ratón y scroll suave.

motion.motion_signature: scrubbed scale-up reveal with rAF mouse parallax — scroll progress linearly interpolates translateY (-105..-135% → 0), scale (0.25 → 1), gap (2 → 1em) and a two-segment font-size ramp (80→40px over the first 40% of progress, then 40→20px), while horizontal mouse offset is exponentially smoothed at lerp 0.05 and gated off once scale ≥ 0.95
